explication: This Terraform module deploys and configures Azure Container Registries. The principal workflow is a user supplying registry and resource settings, then Terraform provisioning the registry and exposing discrete outputs. The repository also has dedicated configuration for cache rules, private endpoints, scope maps, customer-managed keys, and telemetry, plus child modules for cache rules, credential sets, and scope maps. The README documents the registry, supporting Azure resources, and lock behavior; no source excerpts were provided, so internal call relationships are not asserted.
